effort: none: qwen 0.28.4 has no effort flag or variable; its only effort setting is model.reasoningEffort in settings.json, which each provider clamps or drops per model (packages/cli/src/config/settingsSchema.ts)
login: qwen's own login: a Qwen subscription sign-in in ~/.qwen/subscription_credentials.json, or an API key provider in ~/.qwen/settings.json or ~/.qwen/.env, chosen with /auth in an interactive qwen
daemon: qwen may start a detached StopFailure hook supervisor (its own session, output closed) when a configured StopFailure hook fires on loop detection; stop ends it through the Linux subreaper, so this row holds on Linux only
